guide.title: Map Exploration Guide
guide.description: Select any point on the map. The system will use Google Maps to automatically identify the province/city and suggest tourist attractions around that area.

steps.1: Zoom in/out the map to the area you are interested in.
steps.2: Click on the desired location on the map.
steps.3: Wait a few seconds for the system to search and display the list of places in the right column.
steps.4: Click on each place to view more details.

guide.note: Note: Results are combined from system data and Google Places. If no places are found, try selecting a different location near the city/province center.
